Added an accepted-answer note for f13293: the card's answer "bacteria" holds in the broad sense, but the oldest known microfossils (Apex chert, ~3.465 billion years; Schopf/Valley 2017) include archaea as well as bacteria, so "microbes"/"prokaryotes" must also count.

changes.new: Oldest organisms: "microbes" or "prokaryotes" is also accepted – the oldest known microfossils (about 3.5 billion years) include archaea as well as bacteria.
Älteste Organismen: Auch „Mikroben“ oder „Prokaryoten“ gelten – unter den ältesten bekannten Mikrofossilien (etwa 3,5 Milliarden Jahre) sind neben Bakterien auch Archaeen.
Древнейшие организмы: засчитываются также ответы «микробы» или «прокариоты» – среди древнейших известных микрофоссилий (около 3,5 миллиарда лет) есть не только бактерии, но и археи.
